content.text: Plan Your Trip to Antigua: Best of Antigua TourismWhat is Travelers’ Choice Best of the Best?This award is our highest recognition and is presented annually to those businesses that are the Best of the Best on Tripadvisor, those that earn excellent reviews from travelers and are ranked in the top 1% of properties worldwide.Learn moreBy GigglesbubblesSave this place to a Trip, where you can track your faves and get personalized picks as you plan.Antigua has hundreds of beaches, from the bustling Pigeon Point to the kitesurfing paradise of Jabberwock Beach. It's fun to mix it up—a day spent in a secluded cove, another spent people-watching at a tourist magnet. When you’re tired of sun and sand you can shoot ‘em up at Reservoir Range, where archery and air pistols are a fun way to work out any lingering pre-vacation stress. A tour of the Antigua Distillery is a spirited way to experience a true taste of the island.Discover your perfect AntiguaLooking for places to stay, eat, or explore?Essential AntiguaPick a category to filter your recsRelated StoriesTrending in the forumsAntigua Is Great ForSnorkeling4WD ToursSand & surfAfter darkExplore more from our sponsorsAntigua travel tipsPowered by AIThese questions and answers were created by AI, using the most common questions travelers ask in the forums.Variety of AccommodationsAccording to forum posts, Antigua offers a diverse array of accommodation options. Travelers have called out Carlisle Bay for its excellent food, lovely beach, and quality accommodations, particularly appealing for its calm waters and proximity to Jolly Harbour for additional dining options.Adults-Only OptionsFor adults-only accommodations, Cocobay and Keyonna Beach Resort are frequently recommended. Cocobay is praised for its picturesque setting and atmosphere, while Keyonna is noted for its privacy, excellent food, and allocated beach beds, making it ideal for couples seeking a tranquil escape.Family-Friendly and Budget OptionsSome travelers mentioned Jolly Beach Resort as a budget-friendly choice that is close to local amenities, including bars and restaurants. For families, Carlisle Bay is also recommended due to its good room configurations and direct beach access, which could be beneficial for those with mobility issues.Luxury and All-InclusiveFor a more luxurious stay, Curtain Bluff and Galley Bay Resort are suggested. Curtain Bluff is recognized for its exceptional all-inclusive package and high-quality service, whereas Galley Bay offers a beautiful beach and great service but may have rougher waters during the winter months.This summary was generated by AI from Tripadvisor forum posts. Was this helpful?Snorkeling OptionsAccording to forum posts, several spots for snorkeling are recommended in Antigua, such as Galleon Beach, Carlisle Bay, and Cades Reef. However, the clarity and quality of the snorkeling experience may vary, and some areas might require access by boat.Diving and Sailing ToursSome travelers mentioned that there are dive centers and sailing tours available, particularly around Carlisle Bay and English Harbour. DiveCarib and Adventure Antigua are cited as reputable operators for diving and snorkeling excursions.Kayaking and Other Water SportsPosts indicate that kayaking is popular, with tours available in the North Sound area. Additionally, water sports like stand-up paddleboarding (SUP) and jet skiing are available, with some tours offering these activities as part of a package.Unique Water ExperiencesFor a unique experience, travelers have recommended Stingray City, where visitors can swim with stingrays in a controlled environment. This is often highlighted as a must-do activity in Antigua.This summary was generated by AI from Tripadvisor forum posts. Was this helpful?Local Car Rental RecommendationsAccording to forum posts, many travelers recommend using local car rental agencies over big franchises for better service and value. Recommended local companies include Pete's, Capital, Bigs, Titi, and Sunny Rentals. These companies are favored for their interest in repeat business and generally better customer service.Experience with Specific CompaniesSome travelers have shared specific positive experiences, such as with Pete’s Car Rental, praised for prompt responses and convenience in delivery and pickup of cars. However, experiences with companies like Capital have been mixed, with some users reporting poorly maintained vehicles.Insurance and Payment OptionsTravelers have noted that Collision Damage Waiver (CDW) is optional in Antigua, and using a credit card that includes CDW can help reduce rental costs. Companies like Pete's are reported to accept multiple forms of payment, including cash and card, directly upon service delivery.This summary was generated by AI from Tripadvisor forum posts. Was this helpful?General OverviewAccording to forum posts, the accommodations at Jolly Beach Resort are generally considered basic and in need of renovation. Some travelers have mentioned that the rooms are adequate if upgraded, but otherwise tend to be rustic and small.Room QualityTravelers have called out that the resort's rooms require more than just superficial updates, with some users expressing disappointment with the cleanliness and overall condition. There have been varied experiences, with some guests finding the renovated rooms acceptable and clean, while others felt unsafe due to the aggressive vendors on the public beach adjacent to the resort.Guest ExperienceFor many users, the appeal of Jolly Beach Resort lies in its location and value for money, offering easy access to a beautiful beach and local amenities in Jolly Harbour. Despite concerns about room quality, the beachfront and nearby dining options are frequently praised.Current StatusRecent posts indicate that Jolly Beach Resort has been closed for a period and was undergoing management changes, which may affect the current and future state of the accommodations and services offered.This summary was generated by AI from Tripadvisor forum posts. Was this helpful?Beach Proximity and AmenitiesAccording to forum posts, Fort James Beach is a popular choice for cruise passengers due to its proximity to the port, approximately 10 minutes by taxi. It offers amenities like Beachlimerz bar and restaurant, sun loungers, and historical sites like Fort James for exploration.Alternative BeachesTravelers have also recommended Dickenson Bay, which is about 4 miles from the port and accessible by taxi. It is known for its lively atmosphere with bars and restaurants, although it can be crowded when cruise ships are in port.Beach TransportationFor transport to these beaches, users have suggested taking a taxi, noting that taxi fares are reasonable, around US$6 each way to Fort James Beach. It's advised to choose a quieter taxi driver away from the crowd for better negotiation and service.This summary was generated by AI from Tripadvisor forum posts. Was this helpful?Shore Fishing LocationsAccording to forum posts, popular shore fishing spots in Antigua include English Harbour, Urlings, Long Bay, Dian Bay area, and Carlisle Bay. These areas offer a variety of fish, including tarpon, snook, snapper, jacks, grouper, bonefish, and barracuda.Jolly Harbour FishingSome travelers have highlighted Jolly Harbour as a notable spot for catching tarpon. The harbor is accessible and popular among those staying in nearby accommodations, making it a convenient location for fishing enthusiasts.Additional Fishing InsightsTravelers have called out the variety of fishing experiences around the island, noting that different areas are suitable for catching different types of fish. For instance, the harbors and mangroves are good for tarpon and snook, while the reefs are better for snapper and grouper.This summary was generated by AI from Tripadvisor forum posts. Was this helpful?Recommended RestaurantsAccording to forum posts, travelers have recommended various dining establishments in Antigua. Some popular choices include Catherine's Cafe for its beachside ambiance and Casa Roots for a lovely dinner experience. Roti King and Roti Sue are favored for authentic local cuisine.Local and International CuisineFor those interested in a mix of local and international dishes, Sheer Rocks and Jacquie O's are high-end options known for quality food. For a taste of the local culinary scene, Sunset Horizon is noted for jerk dishes, and Shanaz's is known for curry.Unique Dining ExperiencesTravelers have called out specific dining experiences such as the afternoon tea at Vintage Tea House on Fig Tree Drive and the beach grill ambiance at Catherine’s at Pigeon Beach. For a memorable high-end meal, Nobu in Barbuda offers fine dining with a sea view and excellent service.This summary was generated by AI from Tripadvisor forum posts. Was this helpful?Taxi TransportationAccording to forum posts, many travelers recommend taking a taxi from the port to Stingray City. The taxi fare is approximately $20 for up to four people, with an additional per person charge for each extra passenger. It's suggested to arrange with your taxi driver to pick you up later and not to pay until after the return journey to ensure reliability.Tour OptionsSome travelers mentioned that booking a tour might be more convenient for visiting Stingray City. Adventure Antigua’s “Xtreme Navigation” tour includes a visit to Stingray City among other activities. Alternatively, Antigua VIP tours can customize a package that includes a visit to Stingray City, along with other attractions and amenities.Booking AdviceFor many users, it's advisable to pre-book your visit to Stingray City, especially during busy periods like cruise ship days. This ensures availability and can prevent disappointment upon arrival. Websites such as stingraycityantigua.com provide options for booking tours directly.This summary was generated by AI from Tripadvisor forum posts. Please read full forum posts for more details and information.Frequently Asked Questions about AntiguaIf you're a more budget-conscious traveler, then you may want to consider traveling to Antigua between September and November, when hotel prices are generally the lowest. Peak hotel prices generally start between June and August.
